'''Fex-M3''' was a neurotoxin that was both potent and volatile. It attacked the [[Brain/Legends|brain]] stem and autonomic [[nervous system]] of most [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was most potent when inhaled, but the chemical could be absorbed through the skin<ref name="MB">[[Star Wars Miniatures Battles (first edition)|''Star Wars Miniatures Battles'', First Edition]]</ref> and injected into the [[Blood/Legends|bloodstream]] where it could cause [[Death/Legends|death]] in less than ten [[Standard second|seconds]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

It was used extensively by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and members of the [[Assassin's Guild/Legends|Assassin's Guild]]. Usually delivered as the coating on a [[Poison dart/Legends|poison dart]], this toxin could kill a target silently in less than 10 seconds, by causing the brain to release its stored energy, thus boiling the target's brain.<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] used darts laced with this substance in his knee pad dart launchers. The [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] used it with the [[CSPL-12 projectile launcher/Legends|CSPL-12]] [[Projectile launcher/Legends|projectile launcher]].

This toxin was used as late as [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] by riot control [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] officers during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].

{{Cutstart}}
A more potent variant of it, known as [[Fex-EX]] was produced.<ref name="Love Is a Warm Blaster">{{JournalCite|17|Love Is a Warm Blaster}}</ref>
{{Cutend}}
